<template>
    <v-card>
      <v-card-title>Summary</v-card-title>
      <v-card-text>
        <v-list>
          <v-list-item v-for="(value, key) in summary" :key="key">
            <v-list-item-title>{{ key }}</v-list-item-title>
            <v-list-item-subtitle>{{ value }}</v-list-item-subtitle>
          </v-list-item>
        </v-list>
      </v-card-text>
    </v-card>
  </template>
  
  <script>
  export default {
    name: 'SummaryCard',
    props: {
      summary: {
        type: Object,
        required: true,
      },
    },
  }
  </script>
